tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, sidebars, queue rows, menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the drop zone at rest, the payout tray behind sheets, slider tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panel edges. Decorative only, never a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, segmented controls, drop-zone dash). 3:1 on surface and paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, units. 4.5:1+ on paper, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: The one accent: the Print action, the active page, progress already burned. Use sparingly; never for decoration.

tokens.name: heat-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of heat fills.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a heat fill.

tokens.name: heat-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active drop zone, selected segment background. Pair with ink text.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: A page thumbnail: always paper-white in both themes, because it shows the physical print.

tokens.name: sheet-ink
tokens.usage: Marks inside a sheet thumbnail. Pure black: thermal paper has no grey.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Printer ready, file rendered. Always with a word (Ready, Connected).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Bluetooth (slow), low paper, long jobs. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Printer not found, render failed, remove file. Always with a word or icon; darker than ok in light theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the empty-state headline or the job title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop PDFs, Markdown, text or photos.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Hold power 3s until the light is solid red
styles.usage: Hints and helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in the job summary.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The big numbers in the job summary: pages, paper length, time.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Page numbers, dimensions, sizes, device paths.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between sheets in the payout.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, control horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between panels; drop-zone inner padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Sheet thumbnails: paper is nearly square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, segments, file-type tags, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, drop zone, queue.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Printer status pill, progress bar ends.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheet thumbnails only: paper lifts off the tray. Panels use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and the drag ghost.
